name: RGD-35-14
summary: RGD-35-14 is a direct-drive electric rotary gripper for precision positioning, assembly and handling of small electronics or semiconductor parts. Its integrated gripping and rotation axes provide a 14 mm stroke, 10-35 N force per jaw and continuous rotation with zero rotary backlash. Optional braking and configurable motion support automated positioning tasks.

description.en: RGD-35-14 is a direct-drive electric rotary gripper for precision positioning, assembly and handling of small electronics or semiconductor parts.
